about: The shop's mods: what the page says about each one. make_shop.py builds every entry's sources for each target below, checks the .m8x the way core does, and writes catalog.json with each file's sha256. Edited by hand. category: a key of categories. motif: the cover's line art. dev: shown only with 'Show developer mods'. on_unit: what was checked on real hardware.

mods.title: Model:01 tick test
mods.summary: Writes dirtyloader/model01-tick.txt after its tick handler has run 16 times.
mods.details: Copy the mod to dirtyloader/mods on the card and enable it in MOD LOADER.
mods.on_unit: Loaded and ran on a Model:01 6.6.4A.

mods.title: CHAOS CONTROL
mods.summary: A Kaoss-style X/Y effects pad on the master output: twelve effects (filter, repeat, tape stop, echo, jet, pitch, scratch, grain, swirl...). Play it with the touch screen, the keys or MIDI CC 12-15. Open it from the MOD LOADER: EDIT on its card shows the FXPAD.
mods.details: On the Model:02, CHAOS mode is the visualizer: FXPAD draws a 38 x 38 LED pad that swirls, ripples or shows the tracks around your finger, for about a third of the stock scopes' cost. On the Headless, the mod opens its own screen and MIDI plays it. Settings (effect, hold, the visual) are rows in its OPTIONS page in the MOD LOADER (all four directions). On the Headless, all four directions open its screen.
keys: MOD LOADER > CHAOS CONTROL > EDIT: CHAOS mode (the FXPAD; Headless: all four directions)
Touch / keys / CC 12-15: X, Y, on, effect
FULLSCREEN button (the pad's top right) or CC 17: the pad on the whole screen; OPT: back
mods.on_unit: Played on a Model:02 6.6.2A with the touch screen (FILTER, the three FXPAD styles) and on a Headless 6.6.4A over MIDI (all twelve effects).

mods.title: LFO SENDS
mods.summary: DRY, MFX, DEL and REV SEND become modulation destinations in all six sound engines, so an LFO or envelope can pump a track's sends. Saved with the song.
mods.details: Pick DRY SEND, MFX SEND, DEL SEND or REV SEND as a modulator's DEST like any other destination. The amounts are saved in the song (a side table core keeps by name).
keys: Instrument > MODS: DEST lists the four sends
mods.on_unit: Checked on a Model:02 6.6.2A (DRY pumps, the destination survives a reload) and a Headless 6.6.4A.

mods.title: FX REPLACE
mods.summary: Replaces the reverb send effect with the mod's own: an example of core's ev_fx_audio, which hands a mod a send effect's audio block.
mods.details: A starting point for a send effect of your own: the reverb's input comes to the mod, and what it writes is the reverb's output.

mods.title: PERF MON
mods.summary: How busy your M8 is: the audio block's time, the frame's time and the screen's, measured with the CPU's cycle counter. A page in the MOD LOADER, and over USB.
mods.details: Shows the audio callback's load against its 2.9 ms budget, the UI frame time and the display refresh. Useful before adding a heavy mod.
keys: MOD LOADER (all four directions) > PERF MON; Headless: LEFT+RIGHT
mods.on_unit: Used on a Model:02 6.6.2A and a Headless 6.6.4A for the headroom measurements in docs/PERF-MON.md.

mods.title: load-gen
mods.summary: A CPU load you dial in with MIDI CC 20 (audio thread) and CC 21 (UI), for headroom tests with PERF MON.
mods.details: It adds busy work to the audio block or the UI frame, so you can see how much room is left before the M8 drops audio or frames.
mods.on_unit: Used for the headroom sweep in docs/PERF-MON.md.

mods.title: Core API demo
mods.summary: Core's API from a mod: MIDI in and out, a page, a setting, an extra modulation destination (WAV DEMO).
mods.details: Read its source for how a mod uses dl/core.h. Its WAV DEMO destination takes WAVSYNTH's only free slot, so it and LFO SENDS don't go together.

mods.title: Core self-test
mods.summary: Counts every event core fires, for checking a core build on a unit. Uses many hook slots: switch it off after.
mods.details: PEEK its counters over USB, or read its page.
mods.on_unit: Used to check core 0.3 to 0.7 on a Headless 6.6.4A.

mods.title: flash-probe
mods.summary: A mod too big for ITCM on purpose: core installs it from the card into flash. Shows that the flash path works.

mods.title: SD heartbeat
mods.summary: Writes a boot marker to the SD card and blinks the LED on a bare Teensy.
mods.details: Delete dirtyloader/sd-heartbeat.txt and restart with the mod enabled to check for a fresh marker. Model:01 needs firmware with the SD write API.
mods.on_unit: The previous version was checked on Headless and Model:02 6.6.4A.

mods.title: Audio tone
mods.summary: Replaces the output with a 440 Hz tone: an example of ev_audio_out. Loud: not for a song.

mods.title: Track silence
mods.summary: Silences track 1: an example of ev_track_audio, which hands a mod each track's audio.
mods.details: Model:01 requires Dirtyloader firmware with the track audio hook.
